title: kurtosis and skewness raise where a moment is out of range
verdict: decided: black-box aggregates that may raise
description: `kurtosis`, `kurtosis_pop` and `skewness` of DOUBLEs (integers convert) raise an Out of Range Error (`Kurtosis is out of range!`, `SKEW is out of range!`) for a group with an infinity or NaN, or a value whose fourth power (third, for `skewness`) overflows: from about 1e77 for the kurtoses (1e76 passes, 1e77 raises) and later for `skewness` (1e100 passes, 1e300 raises).

`kurtosis` (of a sample) is NULL for fewer than 4 values, `skewness` for fewer than 3, `kurtosis_pop` for fewer than 2, and all three for values that are all equal. `kurtosis_pop` of 2 values can be -2.0 (1.0 and 2.0), of 3 values -1.5. (Corrected 2026-11-04: this said `kurtosis_pop` is NULL for fewer than 3 values.)
`sem` does not raise: it is NaN for an infinity or NaN, `inf` where the variance overflows, and `0.0` for one value or equal values.
The docs are silent on the raises, the NULL thresholds and zero variance: a docs gap. No upstream test pins the raise on a NaN or infinite input; it may change between versions.
reference: Each is a black box (#326). Aggregates in the table may raise now (`Aggregate.raises`): `verify` reports a domain error for the three moments, on the groups `rawAggRaises` decides, as it does for a variance of an infinity (`AggFn.makesNan`). `sem` is not NULL over values and at least `+0.0`.

evidence.sql: SELECT kurtosis(x), kurtosis_pop(x), skewness(x), sem(x) FROM (VALUES (1.0::DOUBLE), ('inf'::DOUBLE), (2), (3), (4)) t(x)
evidence.observed: Out of Range Error: Kurtosis is out of range!
Out of Range Error: SKEW is out of range!

evidence.sql: SELECT kurtosis(x) FROM (VALUES (1e76::DOUBLE), (-1e76), (2.0), (3.0), (4.0)) t(x); SELECT kurtosis(x) FROM (VALUES (1e77::DOUBLE), (-1e77), (2.0), (3.0), (4.0)) t(x)
evidence.observed: a double; Out of Range Error

evidence.sql: SELECT skewness(x) FROM (VALUES (1e100::DOUBLE), (-1e100), (2.0), (3.0), (4.0)) t(x); SELECT skewness(x) FROM (VALUES (1e300::DOUBLE), (-1e300), (2), (3), (4)) t(x)
evidence.observed: a double; Out of Range Error: SKEW is out of range!

evidence.sql: SELECT kurtosis(x), kurtosis_pop(x), skewness(x), sem(x) FROM (VALUES (1), (2), (3)) t(x)
SELECT kurtosis(x), kurtosis_pop(x), skewness(x), sem(x) FROM (VALUES (1), (1), (1), (1), (1)) t(x)
SELECT sem(x) FROM (VALUES (1.0::DOUBLE), ('inf'::DOUBLE), (2), (3), (4)) t(x); SELECT sem(x) FROM (VALUES (1e300::DOUBLE), (-1e300), (2)) t(x)

evidence.note: NULL for n <= 1 (kurtosis_pop) or n <= 3 (kurtosis) or M2 <= 0; raises 'Kurtosis is out of range!' on a non-finite result
NULL for n <= 2 or M2 <= 0; raises 'SKEW is out of range!' on a non-finite result

provenance.notes: Corrected the description: `kurtosis_pop` is NULL for fewer than 2 values (n ≤ 1), not fewer than 3.

evidence.note: kurtosis, kurtosis_pop, skewness, sem: definitions only; silent on raises and NULL thresholds
kurtosis_pop of 1.0, 2.0 → -2.0: two values are enough

evidence.sql: select kurtosis_pop(x), skewness(x), kurtosis(x) from (values (1.0::double),(2.0)) t(x)
